concept: India under East India Company’s Rule
question: The Government of India Act was passed in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1858**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Government of India Act of 1858 __- 

 
 
• This act was enacted in the wake of the Revolt of 1857.
 
• It was also known as the First War of Independence or the 'sepoy mutiny'.
 
• The act is known as the Act for the Good Government of India.
 
• The act abolished the East India Company and transferred the powers to the British Crown. 
 
• It changed the designation of the Governor-General to that of the Viceroy of India.
 
 
• Lord Canning became the first Viceroy of India.
 
 
 
• It ended the system of double government by abolishing the Board of Control and Court of Directors.
 
• It created a new office, the Secretary of State for India having complete authority over the Indian Administration.
 
• It established a 15-member Council of India to assist the secretary of state for India.
